task.original_request: Create a report sample that makes failed, blocked, and needs_rework work items obvious.
success_criteria: The report puts attention items above successful items.
The report explains why each attention item needs follow-up.
The report does not hide missing evidence.

work_items.title: Implement base report generator
work_items.summary: Generated an initial HTML report from structured context.

work_items.title: Review attention handling
work_items.summary: Review found that evidence for one claim was too weak and should be rewritten before formal reporting.

work_items.title: Publish report externally
work_items.summary: External publishing is intentionally blocked until readability samples pass human review.

work_items.title: Validate dashboard embedding
work_items.summary: Dashboard embedding was not attempted because the spike has not passed the readability gate.

commands.summary: Targeted spike tests passed before sample generation.

risks: A report that hides needs_rework or blocked items would fail the spike even if all files are generated.
Human review can reject a report that passes rule checks.
open_questions: Which visual density level is most useful for the workflow owner?
